manual-ecosystem-browse.name: Explore the complete ecosystem
manual-ecosystem-browse.description: Todos los roles entran desde el manual y consultan los siete espacios con sus pantallas.

manual-ecosystem-navigate.name: Navigate ecosystem levels
manual-ecosystem-navigate.description: Seleccionar un espacio, módulo y pantalla; volver al nivel anterior.

manual-ecosystem-search.description: Buscar un módulo por su nombre o descripción y seleccionarlo.

manual-ecosystem-search-empty.name: Unmatched ecosystem search
manual-ecosystem-search-empty.description: Buscar un término sin coincidencias y ver el estado vacío.

manual-ecosystem-tour.name: Follow an ecosystem tour
manual-ecosystem-tour.description: Iniciar un recorrido, avanzar o volver entre módulos y terminar o salir.

manual-ecosystem-relations.name: Toggle ecosystem connections
manual-ecosystem-relations.description: Ocultar o mostrar las conexiones operativas del nivel actual.

manual-ecosystem-share.name: Restore an ecosystem selection
manual-ecosystem-share.description: Recargar el enlace del módulo seleccionado y recuperar su contexto.

manual-ecosystem-share-invalid.name: Recover an invalid ecosystem link
manual-ecosystem-share-invalid.description: Abrir un enlace con nodo o recorrido desconocido y volver a una selección válida.

manual-ecosystem-access.name: Explore restricted module descriptions
manual-ecosystem-access.description: Un adoptante consulta un módulo administrativo y ve su audiencia sin un enlace de acceso.

manual-ecosystem-guide.name: Return to the role-filtered manual
manual-ecosystem-guide.description: Volver desde el mapa a la guía conservando el filtro de procesos por rol.

manual-ecosystem-auth.name: Protect ecosystem access
manual-ecosystem-auth.description: Un visitante sin sesión recibe la redirección al inicio de sesión.

manual-ecosystem-orbit.name: Control the ecosystem orbit
manual-ecosystem-orbit.description: Ajustar la órbita mediante teclado, arrastre, zoom, centrado y pausa.

manual-ecosystem-responsive.name: Explore ecosystem cards
manual-ecosystem-responsive.description: Navegar por tarjetas en 412, 835 y 1195 px sin desbordamiento horizontal.

manual-ecosystem-locale.name: Explore the English ecosystem
manual-ecosystem-locale.description: Entrar desde el manual inglés y consultar un módulo en ese idioma.

home-loads.name: Home page loads
home-loads.description: Home page renders with hero, featured animals, and shelter spotlight

home-to-animals.name: Navigate from home to animals
home-to-animals.description: User clicks explore animals CTA on home page and navigates to /animals

home-to-campaigns.name: Navigate from home to campaigns
home-to-campaigns.description: User clicks active campaigns section and navigates to /campaigns

auth-admin-token-handoff.name: Admin token handoff redirect
auth-admin-token-handoff.description: Browser lands on /admin-login with access+refresh tokens in URL params; tokens are stored in cookies and user is redirected to the target page (or / if absent). Missing tokens redirect to /sign-in. Out of Playwright scope: all 4 token-handoff branches (missing token, tokens + redirect param, tokens + no redirect param, loading state) are pinned by app/[locale]/admin-login/__tests__/page.test.tsx with concrete redirect-target assertions (toHaveBeenCalledWith)

auth-sign-in-form.name: Sign-in form display and interaction
auth-sign-in-form.description: User navigates to /sign-in, sees form fields and can type in them

auth-login-invalid.name: Login with invalid credentials
auth-login-invalid.description: User submits invalid credentials and stays on sign-in page with error

auth-sign-up-form.name: Sign-up form display and validation
auth-sign-up-form.description: User navigates to /sign-up and sees registration form with client-side validation

auth-forgot-password-form.name: Forgot password form display
auth-forgot-password-form.description: User navigates to /forgot-password and sees email input and send code button

auth-forgot-password-reset.name: Forgot password complete reset wizard
auth-forgot-password-reset.description: User completes the full reset wizard on /forgot-password: (1) enters email and sends code, (2) enters the 6-digit code, (3) sets a new password that passes strength validation, (4) sees success state and is redirected to /sign-in

auth-login-redirect.name: Sign-in with post-login redirect
auth-login-redirect.description: User arrives at /sign-in?redirect=/some-path (from a protected-route gate), signs in successfully, and is redirected to /some-path instead of /. Unsafe targets (absolute URLs, protocol-relative //host) fall back to /

auth-sign-up-success.name: Sign-up successful submission
auth-sign-up-success.description: User fills all required sign-up fields with valid data (matching passwords, accepted terms), submits, and is redirected to /sign-in (or home) after the account is created

auth-protected-redirect.name: Protected route redirect
auth-protected-redirect.description: Unauthenticated user accessing protected routes is redirected to /sign-in

auth-role-redirect.name: Role-based navigation
auth-role-redirect.description: Authenticated user sees role-specific navigation links in header. Out of Playwright scope: role-specific nav is pinned at the unit layer (components/layout/__tests__/Header.test.tsx asserts the per-role dropdown contents for shelter_admin/web_manager/admin); the only e2e spec that ever existed for this flow was a mistagged unauthenticated-redirect copy of auth-protected-redirect, not a real role-based-nav check

animal-browse.name: Browse animals listing
animal-browse.description: User visits /animals and sees animal cards grid

animal-filter.name: Filter animals by species/size/age
animal-filter.description: User applies species/size/age filters and sees filtered results

animal-detail.name: View animal detail
animal-detail.description: User clicks an animal card and views detail page with info and gallery

animal-gallery.name: Animal gallery interaction
animal-gallery.description: Animal detail page displays gallery images

shelter-browse.name: Browse shelters listing
shelter-browse.description: User visits /shelters and sees shelter cards

shelter-detail.name: View shelter profile
shelter-detail.description: User clicks a shelter card and views profile with animals and campaigns

shelter-onboarding.name: Shelter registration form
shelter-onboarding.description: Legacy /shelter/onboarding now redirects to /shelter-application (the formal Phase 22 wizard). This flow only verifies the redirect lands correctly; the form itself is gone.

shelter-application-submit.name: Shelter application wizard submit
shelter-application-submit.description: Adopter completes the 4-step wizard at /shelter-application (basic info, legal, deferred documents, motivation) and submits POST /api/shelter-applications/ to formally apply to become a shelter

shelter-application-status.name: Shelter application status view
shelter-application-status.description: Adopter with an existing application visits /shelter-application and sees the status view (submitted / under_review / approved / rejected) instead of the wizard

shelter-application-review.name: Admin reviews shelter application
shelter-application-review.description: Reviewer approves or rejects a shelter application through Django admin / API; approval atomically creates a verified Shelter and promotes the applicant role to shelter_admin. Out of Playwright scope (route lives at Django /admin-site/, not the Next.js app)

adoption-submit.name: Submit adoption application
adoption-submit.description: User submits adoption application from animal detail page

adoption-track.name: Track adoption applications
adoption-track.description: Adopter accesses /my-applications: unauthenticated users are redirected to sign-in; authenticated list and badges are covered by my-applications-list (same test may carry both flow tags)

adoption-manage.name: Manage adoption applications (shelter)
adoption-manage.description: Shelter admin reviews and updates application status at /shelter/applications (same screen as shelter-panel-applications; adoption domain framing)

campaign-browse.name: Browse campaigns
campaign-browse.description: User visits /campaigns and sees campaign cards with progress bars

campaign-detail.name: View campaign detail

donation-checkout.name: Donation checkout flow
donation-checkout.description: User selects amount, payment method, and submits donation at /checkout/donation

donation-history.description: User views donation history at /my-donations (redirect when guest; authenticated list when signed in)

sponsorship-checkout.name: Sponsorship checkout flow

sponsorship-history.name: View sponsorships
sponsorship-history.description: User views sponsorships at /my-sponsorships (redirect when guest; authenticated list when signed in)

favorite-toggle.name: Toggle animal favorite
favorite-toggle.description: User favorites/unfavorites an animal on /animals/[id] (guest gate + authenticated toggle); list appears at /favorites

favorite-list.name: View favorites list
favorite-list.description: User views their favorited animals at /favorites

adopter-intent-create.name: Create adopter intent
adopter-intent-create.description: User creates or updates their adoption intent at /my-intent (redirect when guest; save when authenticated)

adopter-intent-browse.name: Browse adopter intents
adopter-intent-browse.description: User views public adopter intents at /looking-to-adopt
knownGaps: No reachable UI as of 2026-07-27: /looking-to-adopt (looking-to-adopt/page.tsx) is a static info page -- how-it-works list + FAQ accordion + an auth-gated CTA link (Mi Intención / Iniciar sesión) -- with zero adopter-intent cards. GET /api/adopter-intents/ (ADOPTER_INTENTS constant, constants.ts:149) is called by no page or store in the frontend. This is the same dead page already documented as the blocker for shelter-invite-send and shelter-invite-respond (knownGaps, 2026-07-04). Restore expectedSpecs to 1 when a public browsing UI lands.

shelter-panel-dashboard.name: Shelter dashboard
shelter-panel-dashboard.description: Shelter admin views dashboard with navigation to management sections

shelter-panel-animals.name: Shelter manage animals
shelter-panel-animals.description: Shelter admin views and filters their animals at /shelter/animals

shelter-panel-campaigns.name: Shelter manage campaigns
shelter-panel-campaigns.description: Shelter admin views campaigns with progress at /shelter/campaigns

shelter-panel-donations.name: Shelter view donations
shelter-panel-donations.description: Shelter admin views received donations at /shelter/donations

shelter-panel-settings.name: Shelter settings
shelter-panel-settings.description: Shelter admin updates shelter info at /shelter/settings

admin-approve-shelters.name: Admin approve/reject shelters
admin-approve-shelters.description: Admin approves or rejects pending shelters at /admin/shelters/approve

admin-metrics.name: Admin detailed metrics
admin-metrics.description: Admin views financial and adoption metrics at /admin/metrics

navigation-header.name: Header navigation
navigation-header.description: Header renders on every page. Desktop at lg: (1024px+); below that hamburger drawer. Public links: Animales, Refugios, Campañas, Busco Adoptar, Blog, Nosotros dropdown. Authenticated: Panel dropdown per role (shelter_admin 7 items, web_manager 3, admin 6; veterinarian plain link) + Avatar dropdown (Mi Perfil, Favoritos, account items, Cerrar sesión). Mobile: bell link to /my-profile/notifications beside hamburger.

navigation-footer.name: Footer navigation
navigation-footer.description: Footer element is visible with explore, account, and info links

navigation-between-pages.name: Cross-page navigation
navigation-between-pages.description: User navigates across home, /animals, /shelters, /campaigns, and sign-in pages (locale-prefixed URLs)

payment-confirmation.name: Payment confirmation page
payment-confirmation.description: User sees confirmation page after donation/sponsorship checkout

auth-sign-out.name: Sign out
auth-sign-out.description: Authenticated user clicks sign out, tokens are cleared, redirected to /sign-in

auth-session-persistence.name: Session persistence and token refresh
auth-session-persistence.description: User with valid tokens accesses protected route; expired access token triggers refresh

auth-google-login.name: Google OAuth login
auth-google-login.description: User clicks Google sign-in button, completes OAuth, is authenticated and redirected. public-faq.name: FAQ page

public-contact.name: Contact page
public-contact.description: User opens /contactanos with contact form and WhatsApp; can submit message via POST /api/contact/

adopter-profile.name: Adopter profile view
adopter-profile.description: Adopter views their role-adaptive profile dashboard at /my-profile with stats, activity timeline, and completeness bar

shelter-admin-profile.name: Shelter admin profile view
shelter-admin-profile.description: Shelter admin views their role-adaptive profile at /my-profile with ShelterAdminProfileSection (pending-applications widget, shelter stats) and activity timeline with animal_added, campaign_created, application_reviewed, and donation_received events.

admin-profile.name: Admin profile view
admin-profile.description: Admin views their role-adaptive profile at /my-profile with AdminProfileSection (moderation-queue widget, platform stats) and activity timeline with shelter_verified events.

admin-payments.name: Admin payment audit
admin-payments.description: Admin views payment audit table at /admin/payments

blog-browse.name: Blog listing page
blog-browse.description: User browses blog listing at /blog with category filters and search

blog-detail.name: Blog post detail
blog-detail.description: User reads a full blog post at /blog/:slug with content, progress bar, sharing

blog-admin-list.name: Admin blog list
blog-admin-list.description: Admin views all blog posts (published, draft, scheduled) with actions

blog-admin-create.name: Admin blog create
blog-admin-create.description: Admin creates a new blog post via manual form or JSON import

blog-admin-edit.name: Admin blog edit
blog-admin-edit.description: Admin edits an existing blog post fields, JSON content, SEO, cover image

blog-admin-calendar.name: Admin blog calendar
blog-admin-calendar.description: Admin views blog calendar with monthly post overview and status colors

shelter-panel-applications.name: Shelter manage adoption applications
shelter-panel-applications.description: Shelter admin views received adoption applications and changes status (reviewing/interview/approved/rejected) at /shelter/applications

adoption-form-wizard.name: Adoption form wizard completion
adoption-form-wizard.description: Authenticated adopter completes the 3-step adoption wizard (6-section questionnaire, review, submit) for a specific animal

donation-checkout-submit.name: Donation checkout form submission
donation-checkout-submit.description: Authenticated user selects preset amount, chooses payment method (card/PSE/Nequi), fills optional message, and submits donation form

sponsorship-checkout-submit.name: Sponsorship checkout form submission
sponsorship-checkout-submit.description: Authenticated user selects frequency (monthly/one-time), preset amount, payment method, and submits sponsorship form

notification-preferences.name: Notification preferences management
notification-preferences.description: User visits /my-profile/notifications and toggles email/in_app notification preferences per event group

notification-bell.name: Notification bell interaction
notification-bell.description: Authenticated user sees bell icon with unread count, opens dropdown, views notifications, and clicks mark all read

shelter-panel-updates.name: Shelter manage update posts
shelter-panel-updates.description: Shelter admin views and manages update posts at /shelter/updates

shelter-panel-update-create.name: Shelter create update post
shelter-panel-update-create.description: Shelter admin creates a new update post with content and images at /shelter/updates/create

shelter-detail-view-animals.name: Shelter detail view animals link
shelter-detail-view-animals.description: User clicks View Animals on shelter detail page and sees filtered animal list for that shelter

locale-switch.name: Locale switcher toggle
locale-switch.description: User toggles ES/EN locale switcher in header and page content re-renders in the target language

campaign-tab-toggle.name: Campaign tab toggle
campaign-tab-toggle.description: User toggles between Active and Completed tabs on campaigns listing and sees correct campaigns in each

campaign-donate-cta.name: Campaign donate CTA
campaign-donate-cta.description: User clicks Donate CTA on campaign detail page and is routed to donation checkout with campaign context

shelter-detail-gallery.name: Shelter detail gallery lightbox
shelter-detail-gallery.description: User opens lightbox gallery on shelter detail page and navigates images

shelter-detail-video.name: Shelter detail video modal
shelter-detail-video.description: User opens the shelter presentation video in a modal player on the shelter detail page

home-featured-animals-carousel.name: Home featured animals carousel
home-featured-animals-carousel.description: User interacts with featured animals carousel on home page (next/prev navigation, click card)

home-active-campaigns-carousel.name: Home active campaigns carousel
home-active-campaigns-carousel.description: User interacts with active campaigns carousel on home page (next/prev navigation, click card)

public-about.name: About page
public-about.description: User visits /about and sees organization information

public-terms.name: Terms page
public-terms.description: User visits /terms and sees terms of service content

public-strategic-allies.name: Strategic allies page
public-strategic-allies.description: User visits /strategic-allies and sees partner organizations

my-applications-list.name: View my adoption applications
my-applications-list.description: Authenticated adopter views submitted applications at /my-applications with status badges and application details

vet-follow-ups-list.name: Veterinarian follow-ups list
vet-follow-ups-list.description: Veterinarian views their assigned follow-up list at /veterinarian/follow-ups with status badges (pending, in_progress, completed, overdue)

vet-follow-up-detail.name: Veterinarian follow-up detail
vet-follow-up-detail.description: Veterinarian views a follow-up detail, adds clinical history entries, and marks the follow-up as complete

web-manager-shelters.name: Web manager shelter list
web-manager-shelters.description: Web manager browses and filters shelters by verification status at /web-manager/shelters

web-manager-shelter-detail.name: Web manager shelter detail
web-manager-shelter-detail.description: Web manager views shelter info and adoption applications for a specific shelter at /web-manager/shelters/[id]

web-manager-applications.name: Web manager applications list
web-manager-applications.description: Web manager views all adoption applications with status filter at /web-manager/applications

adoption-application-history.name: Adoption application clinical history
adoption-application-history.description: Adopter views clinical history entries for their adoption application's animal at /my-applications/[id]/history

adoption-detail-adopter.name: Adoption application detail (adopter)
adoption-detail-adopter.description: Adopter opens /my-applications/[id]; sees status badge, ApplicationTimeline, WhatsApp card to shelter when status is interview/approved, read-only event timeline, link to clinical history

adoption-whatsapp-shelter.name: Adopter contacts shelter via WhatsApp
adoption-whatsapp-shelter.description: On /my-applications/[id] when status is interview/approved, adopter clicks the WhatsApp card; opens wa.me/<digits>?text=<prefilled> in a new tab using Shelter.phone

adoption-whatsapp-applicant.name: Shelter or web manager contacts adopter via WhatsApp
adoption-whatsapp-applicant.description: From /shelter/applications (expanded card) or /web-manager/applications/[id], the reviewer clicks the WhatsApp card to open wa.me/<digits> using User.phone of the adopter

adoption-event-create-shelter.name: Shelter admin logs an adoption process event
adoption-event-create-shelter.description: On /shelter/applications, shelter admin expands an interview/approved application, opens the event modal, fills date + description, submits POST /api/adoptions/<pk>/events/; timeline updates and follow-up timer resets to +5 days

adoption-event-create-web-manager.name: Web manager logs an adoption process event
adoption-event-create-web-manager.description: On /web-manager/applications/[id], web manager opens the event modal, fills date + description, submits POST /api/adoptions/<pk>/events/; the badge 'Próximo recordatorio en N días' refreshes optimistically

adoption-detail-web-manager.name: Adoption application detail (web manager)
adoption-detail-web-manager.description: Web manager opens /web-manager/applications/[id] from the table; sees applicant email, status badge, follow-up reminder badge when status=interview, and editable event timeline

adoption-followup-reminder.name: Cron-driven follow-up reminder to web managers
adoption-followup-reminder.description: Backend Huey periodic task adoption_interview_follow_ups (09:00 UTC daily) emails every active web_manager about applications stuck in interview and resets next_follow_up_due_at; gated by ADOPTION_FOLLOW_UPS_ENABLED

volunteer-apply.name: Submit volunteer application
volunteer-apply.description: User fills out and submits volunteer application form at /work-with-us/apply/[positionId] with reCAPTCHA verification

profile-edit.name: Edit user profile
profile-edit.description: Authenticated user edits profile fields (name, phone, city) at /my-profile/edit and saves changes; role-specific sections shown for shelter_admin and admin

favorites-compare.name: Compare favorited animals
favorites-compare.description: Authenticated user selects 2+ favorited animals and views side-by-side attribute comparison

favorite-note-edit.name: Edit favorite animal note
favorite-note-edit.description: Authenticated user edits the personal note on a favorited animal at /favorites via inline text input

blog-admin-delete.name: Admin delete blog post
blog-admin-delete.description: Admin deletes a blog post from the admin list with confirmation dialog

blog-admin-duplicate.name: Admin duplicate blog post
blog-admin-duplicate.description: Admin duplicates a blog post from the admin list, creating a new draft copy

shelter-panel-campaign-detail.name: Shelter campaign detail and edit
shelter-panel-campaign-detail.description: Shelter admin views campaign detail, edits title/description/goal when pending or rejected, resubmits for approval, and exchanges messages via CampaignMessageThread at /shelter/campaigns/[id]

shelter-panel-campaign-create.name: Shelter create new campaign
shelter-panel-campaign-create.description: Shelter admin submits a new campaign request (title ES/EN, description, goal) at /shelter/campaigns/nueva; campaign is created as draft pending review

web-manager-campaigns.name: Web manager campaigns list
web-manager-campaigns.description: Web manager browses and filters campaigns by approval status (pending/approved/rejected/all) at /web-manager/campaigns and navigates to campaign detail or new campaign form

web-manager-campaign-detail.name: Web manager campaign approve/reject
web-manager-campaign-detail.description: Web manager views campaign detail, approves or rejects it with a reason, and exchanges messages with the shelter admin via CampaignMessageThread at /web-manager/campaigns/[id]

web-manager-campaign-create.name: Web manager create campaign
web-manager-campaign-create.description: Web manager creates a campaign on behalf of any shelter (auto-approved) at /web-manager/campaigns/new using the shelter dropdown and bilingual form fields. Declares no failure class: createCampaign has no try/catch (lib/stores/campaignStore.ts:85-91), so page.tsx:49 renders the raw Axios err.message for every non-2xx — a 5xx is indistinguishable from a 4xx except for the status digit, and a test asserting that difference would verify the HTTP client, not this flow. Restore the class if 5xx ever maps to its own copy.

manual-browse.name: Interactive manual page load
manual-browse.description: Any authenticated user navigates to /manual; unauthenticated users are redirected to /sign-in; page renders sticky search bar and collapsible sidebar with 9 process sections; web_manager/admin see all sections; other roles see only their relevant filtered sections (Phase 19 filterByRole). User expands a section and clicks an anchor link, which scrolls to the ProcessCard and fires a 1.6 s highlight ring.

manual-search.name: Manual search and process navigation
manual-search.description: Authenticated user types a query (or Cmd/Ctrl+K) into the Fuse.js search bar on /manual; dropdown shows ranked results filtered by role; user selects a result via keyboard or click; page scrolls to the matching ProcessCard. Search index respects role-filtered section visibility (Phase 19).

manual-role-filter.name: Manual content filtered by role
manual-role-filter.description: Authenticated user with a non-staff role (adopter, shelter_admin, veterinarian) visits /manual and sees only the process sections relevant to their role (via filterByRole.ts). Staff roles (web_manager, admin) see all sections. Sections excluded from a role are not rendered in the sidebar or page body.

web-manager-profile.name: Web manager profile view
web-manager-profile.description: Web manager views their profile at /my-profile: common elements (avatar, name, role badge, completeness bar, Edit Profile button) and role-specific activity timeline with campaign_reviewed events; WebManagerProfileSection shows stat cards (pending shelters, applications, campaigns) and quick action links.

veterinarian-profile.name: Veterinarian profile view
veterinarian-profile.description: Veterinarian views their profile at /my-profile: common elements (avatar, name, role badge, completeness bar) and role-specific activity timeline with clinical_entry and followup_completed events; VeterinarianProfileSection shows follow-up stat cards (pending/in_progress/completed/overdue) and quick action link.

platform-support-info.name: Platform support landing page
platform-support-info.description: User views /apoya-la-plataforma: hero renders with CTA to checkout, cost breakdown cards visible, transparency section visible, comparison grid with 5 ways visible.

donation-platform-checkout.name: Platform donation checkout flow
donation-platform-checkout.description: Authenticated adopter navigates to /checkout/platform, selects an amount, submits, and is redirected to /checkout/confirmation with dest=platform in the query string.

shelter-panel-animal-create.name: Shelter create new animal
shelter-panel-animal-create.description: Shelter admin adds a new animal record via the create form at /shelter/animals, filling required fields (name, species, breed, age, gender, status, description) and submitting; animal appears in the shelter's list.
knownGaps: No reachable UI as of 2026-07-27: /shelter/animals/nuevo has no page component anywhere in the app router (confirmed absent from git history: 'git log --all -- *animals/nuevo*' returns nothing). The '+ Agregar animal' link (shelter/animals/page.tsx:46) is a dead CTA for authenticated users -- Next.js serves its default not-found boundary there (no middleware/rewrite maps the path). Unauthenticated users only appear gated because proxy.ts's PROTECTED_PREFIXES matches the '/shelter' prefix before route resolution (proxy.ts:8-19,51-55), not because a create page exists. animalStore.createAnimal (animalStore.ts:96-98) is defined but consumed by no component. Restore expectedSpecs to 1 when a real create form/route lands.

shelter-panel-animal-edit.name: Shelter edit existing animal
shelter-panel-animal-edit.description: Shelter admin opens an existing animal record from /shelter/animals and updates its fields (description, photos, health info, status) via the edit form at /shelter/animals/[id] or an inline modal.
knownGaps: No reachable UI as of 2026-07-04: /shelter/animals is a read-only list linking to the public animal detail; animalStore.updateAnimal and the /shelter/animals/[id] edit route are unused/absent. Restore expectedSpecs to 1 when an edit form/route lands.

shelter-panel-animal-archive.name: Shelter archive animal
shelter-panel-animal-archive.description: Shelter admin archives (soft-deletes) an animal from /shelter/animals with a confirmation step; archived animals are hidden from public listings and excluded from shelter stats.
knownGaps: No reachable UI as of 2026-07-04: /shelter/animals has no archive/delete control and animalStore has no archive method (ANIMAL_DELETE unused). Restore expectedSpecs to 1 when an archive control is added.

auth-password-change.name: Authenticated password change
auth-password-change.description: Authenticated user changes their password via PATCH /api/auth/update_password/ from the profile edit page; requires current password confirmation and new password strength validation before saving.
knownGaps: No reachable UI as of 2026-07-04: /my-profile/edit has no password fields and API_ENDPOINTS.UPDATE_PASSWORD is referenced by no page/store (dead endpoint). Restore expectedSpecs to 1 when a password-change form is wired up.

shelter-invite-send.name: Shelter admin sends adopter invite
shelter-invite-send.description: Shelter admin browses public adopter intents at /looking-to-adopt, views a matching profile, and sends a shelter invite via POST /api/shelter-invites/create/; adopter receives an in-app and email notification.

shelter-invite-respond.name: Adopter responds to shelter invite
shelter-invite-respond.description: Adopter with pending shelter invites sees invite count on /my-profile stats banner, navigates to manage invites, and accepts or rejects via PATCH /api/shelter-invites/[pk]/respond/; invite count updates accordingly.

shelter-panel-campaign-messages.name: Shelter reads and sends campaign approval messages
shelter-panel-campaign-messages.description: Shelter admin opens a campaign detail at /shelter/campaigns/[id] and reads/sends messages in the approval thread with the platform team via GET/POST /api/campaigns/[pk]/messages/.

web-manager-campaign-messages.name: Web manager reads and sends campaign approval messages
web-manager-campaign-messages.description: Web manager or admin opens a campaign detail at /web-manager/campaigns/[id] and reads/sends messages in the approval thread with the shelter via GET/POST /api/campaigns/[pk]/messages/.

notification-mark-all-read.name: Mark all notifications as read
notification-mark-all-read.description: Authenticated user opens the notification bell dropdown in the header and clicks 'mark all read', clearing the unread badge via POST /api/notifications/logs/mark-all-read/.

campaign-updates-feed.name: Read updates feed on a completed campaign
campaign-updates-feed.description: Visitor opens a completed campaign detail page at /campaigns/[campaignId] and reads the progress-updates feed loaded via GET /api/updates/.

profile-activity-feed.name: View recent activity timeline on profile
profile-activity-feed.description: Authenticated user views the recent-activity timeline (applications, donations, sponsorships, favorites) on /my-profile, populated via GET /api/user/activity/.
